tasks.title: Fix Account.Equals to compare (Name, Password)
tasks.notes: Account.Equals now compares both Name and Password. GetHashCode combines both fields via XOR. Commit: 80dac2b.

tasks.title: Fix SetCurrentAccount and AuthView dedup logic
tasks.notes: SetCurrentAccount now checks exact (name, password) pair — same name with different password adds a new entry instead of overwriting. btLogin_Click simplified: name-only dedup prompt removed entirely. Commit: 31bee48.

tasks.title: Enable Login when store has entries (UX-2)
tasks.notes: Full rebuild of btLogin_Click with three-way logic: (1) fields non-empty → SetCurrentAccount, offer Save Y/N, Refresh; (2) fields empty + store non-empty → Refresh (TrySessionWithCredentials iterates store); (3) both empty → MessageBox block. DelegateCommand CanExecute predicate: hasFields OR store count > 0. RaiseCanExecuteChanged on username.TextChanged, password DependencyProperty change, and after CredentialManagerView closes.
